candidates.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
candidates.summary: Benchmark showing agent effectiveness depends on harness as well as model, and tests failure attribution from traces.
candidates.note: Related to covered 'How Tool-Using Agents Fail' (agent failures) - differentiate angle.

candidates.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
candidates.summary: Argues successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily good supervision; synthesizes decision-grounded training environments.

candidates.title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
candidates.summary: Video-language agents that act proactively on implicit, shifting user intent in streaming video instead of waiting for explicit prompts.

candidates.title: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
candidates.summary: Learns collaboration structure among agents dynamically rather than using predefined workflows.

candidates.title: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL
candidates.summary: Rubric-based RL rewards get gamed; a precision-focused objective reduces reward hacking.

candidates.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
candidates.summary: Benchmark for whether agents improve over time from experience while retaining prior knowledge.

candidates.title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
candidates.summary: Localizing brief AI manipulations inside otherwise authentic long videos.

candidates.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
candidates.summary: Survey/perspective on video foundation models and world models as a general medium.

candidates.title: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
candidates.summary: Fixes cross-modal hallucinations in audio-visual LLMs by rebalancing evidence vs. prior.

candidates.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
candidates.summary: Self-distillation post-training without ground truth or stronger teachers.
